clean.tx: No visiem zvēriem lapsa ir visgudrākā.
clean.tl: Among all animals, the fox is the smartest one.

clean.tx: un tas cũkgans a visàm tiẽm cũkam tur i palic:s.
clean.tl: and this swineherd had remained there with all those pigs

flagged.tx: Vel' bi [visâ:ʒ â:d gurc̄] – plattak un šoûrak, me̦l̃':, brũn' un ʒe̦l̂te̦n'.
flagged.tl: Moreover, there were all kinds of belts: thicker ones and thinner ones, black ones, brown ones and yellow ones.
